title: Operations Director
description: Kinetic Homes - Operations Director Introduction: Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years. This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future. Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year. Duties & Responsibilities: Permitting Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects. Complete and submit permit applications for new construction. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications. Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone. Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables. Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation. Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction. Development Support Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team. File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county. Procurement Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing. Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction. Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements. Transaction Support Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts. Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions. Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. Qualifications: University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF. Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively. Possess strong verbal and written English skills. Must be highly organized and attentive to detail. Willing to work in high-pressure environment. Willing to be responsive and communicative. Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST. The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal. Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Gerente De Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso. O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança. Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis. Principais Responsabilidades - Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.
- Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.
- Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.
- Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste. Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.
- Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.
- Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.
- Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.
- Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.
- Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.
- Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente. Requisitos Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.
- Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.
- Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.
- Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.
- Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
- Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.
- Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.
- Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes. Experiência Desejáveis - Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.
- Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.
- Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.
- Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.
- Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.
- Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).
- Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Global Networks Leader
description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services. Main Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance. Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations. Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets. Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices. Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making. Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions. Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements. Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits. Knowledge and experience requiered Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools. Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS. Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control. Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment. Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.G., Ansible, Python). Management & communication Skills Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers. Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.G., operations, finance, senior management). Relevant Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations. Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable. ITIL certification is a plus.
